method: Batch-wide retest/final sweep across current Omgevingsplan, current policies/regulations, municipal product pages, application-document requirements, fees/terms, and future-law/currentness signals.

records.retest: Current municipal woningsplitsing and woningdelen pages reconfirm the 2025 programme framework, urban/rural distinction, parking and Bbl requirements. Current building-permit page confirms Omgevingsloket, DigiD/eHerkenning and that the live application specifies required attachments. 2026 Woo material also confirms registered room-rental/omzettingsvergunning practice exists in the municipality.
remainingAllowedOnly: dynamic attachment set and exact fee for the concrete activity

records.retest: Current Omgevingsplan version effective from 03-04-2026 still contains the detailed special application requirements for splitting, including recent building/foundation/gas-electricity reports and VvE consent where applicable. Bibob policy still lists room-rental and conversion/splitting risk categories. No safely verified successor 2026 tariff amount was found in this sweep, so superseded fees remain excluded.
remainingAllowedOnly: current exact tariff line once positively located

records.retest: Current 2025 BOPA policy remains the substantive generic framework for splitting and room rental. No newer conflicting current instrument was found in the final sweep. Superseded 2026 fee material remains excluded until the current successor tariff is positively matched.

Current Omgevingsplan is confirmed effective from 26-05-2026 and legally integrates related regulations. Current Omgevingsvisie remains effective from 13-01-2026. Previously established application package, concept-request fee and decision periods remain consistent with current official sources.

Current municipal Omgevingsplan page reconfirms one municipal plan with integrated former zoning plans and address-specific rules via Regels op de kaart. No stronger municipality-wide room-rental/splitting instrument was positively established in this sweep; therefore concrete permission remains an address/current-plan outcome rather than an unresolved generic-source defect.

Current municipal page reconfirms Omgevingsloket as the permit check/application channel. Current transitional/integrated plan remains controlling; no municipality-specific housing rule from another municipality is reused. New structured Omgevingsplan remains a future-law/currentness watch for end-2026 adoption.

Current Omgevingsplan remains effective from 15-01-2026. Current 2026 kavelsplitsing framework remains effective and distinct from woningsplitsing/kamerverhuur. No conflicting newer source was found. The room-rental outcome remains tied to the current plan/integrated components for the concrete address.

Major practical closure improvement: current municipal woningsplitsing product confirms mandatory omgevingsvergunning and a concrete application package: DigiD, proof of ownership, dimensioned existing/new floor plans, parking site plan, spatial motivation, expert reports where applicable (noise/nature/parking), and signed neighbour-participation report. Current concept-request fee for woningsplitsing is EUR 153; final permit fee remains project-dependent under the leges regulation.
remainingAllowedOnly: exact project-specific permit fee and any additional case-specific studies

records.retest: Current Omgevingsplan still links the permit assessment for verkamering/splitting directly to the 2026 policy. The 2026 policy remains current and explicitly repealed the 2021 policy from 01-01-2026. No newer conflicting instrument was found. The 2026 transition window remains time-limited and must be rechecked from 01-01-2027.

Current Omgevingsplan version is confirmed effective from 05-05-2026. It still contains the detailed kamerverhuur application requirements including room counts, floor-plan areas, storage areas and Bibob data. Article numbering changed across 2026 plan versions, confirming the earlier QA rule not to hard-code historical article numbers without current-source verification.
